listingTitle: Avoid C# locks with weak identity
title: Avoid C# locks with weak identity
why: Strings, type objects, and publicly reachable instance identities can be shared by unrelated code, allowing external lock contention or deadlock.
suggestion: Lock a private readonly object whose identity is controlled exclusively by the containing type.
limitations: String literals, typeof expressions, this, String.Intern calls, and directly declared string variables are recognized.
Visibility, aliases, inheritance, and other weak-identity framework types are not resolved.
